name: Lingxi X2
summary: AgiBot's small modular humanoid, built for interaction rather than heavy work: 30 joints at up to 120 N·m peak torque, walking at 1.8 m/s, with LiDAR and RGB-D for its own route planning. It is aimed at retail floors and offices where a robot has to move among people and hold their attention.
notable: Modular design tuned for expressive interaction
